title: Praying Open Doors for Nations and Souls
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about the impact of prayer and generosity on nations around the world. Hear how The River Church is being used by God to touch the hearts of Muslims and see the miraculous results of their prayers and support for missionaries. In this sermon, Pastor Zehner will challenge you to pray with expectation and generosity, knowing that your involvement is making a difference in the lives of people across the globe.
